faq.question: Does this create a real Excel XLSX file?
faq.answer: Yes. The download is a real .xlsx workbook with a single worksheet named Sheet1, so you can open it directly in Excel, Google Sheets, and LibreOffice Calc without importing text.

faq.question: Can I choose comma, semicolon, or tab output?
faq.answer: The XLSX download does not use a delimiter, so no delimiter setting is needed. The CSV copy button always uses a comma, because that is what spreadsheets expect when pasting text.

faq.question: What JSON structure works best?
faq.answer: A JSON array of objects works best, where each object is one record. Flat objects export one column per key, and nested objects are flattened when the option is enabled.

faq.question: Can I convert a JSON object instead of an array?
faq.answer: No. The input must be a JSON array. Wrap a single object in an array, for example `[{ ... }]`, or select the array inside the object, such as the `items` array of an API response.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: Yes, when flattening is enabled. Nested objects become dotted columns such as `address.city`, arrays of objects become indexed columns such as `items.0.name`, and arrays of simple values are written as JSON text. Turn the option off to keep nested objects out of the workbook columns.

faq.question: Are all fields exported, or only the fields of the first record?
faq.answer: Columns are collected from every record in the array. A field that is missing from one record becomes an empty cell in that row, so rows stay aligned even when records have different fields.

faq.question: How are numbers, booleans, dates, and null values exported?
faq.answer: Numbers and booleans are written as cells of that type. Null and missing values become empty cells. Dates stay as the original JSON strings, so convert them inside your spreadsheet if you need real date cells.

faq.question: Can I remove the header row?
faq.answer: Yes. Turn off the header option and the workbook and CSV copy will contain data rows only, which is useful when appending below an existing sheet.

faq.question: Can I export multiple worksheets?
faq.answer: No. One conversion produces one worksheet. Convert each array separately if you need several sheets, then combine them in your spreadsheet application.

faq.question: Can I convert large JSON files?
faq.answer: The practical limit depends on browser memory, device performance, and record count. Very large arrays take longer to flatten and export, and may exhaust available memory.

faq.question: Is my JSON uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: The workbook is generated in your browser and does not require a server upload. You should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, tokens, or confidential customer data into any browser-based tool.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to Excel converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste JSON or open a file, preview the rows, and download the XLSX workbook without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert JSON to Excel (XLSX)
article.content:
What this JSON to Excel converter does

A JSON to Excel converter turns a JSON array of objects into an XLSX worksheet: each array item becomes a row and the detected fields become columns. The downloaded file is a real workbook you can open directly, not plain text you must import through a wizard.

It restructures data; it does not analyse it. It does not build charts, pivot tables, or formulas, and it does not decide which fields to merge.

Common use cases

  • Business analysis: Export API records to a sheet your colleagues open in Excel.
  • Data delivery: Hand operations, finance, or clients a file they can open directly.
  • Review and audit: Flatten records into rows to check missing fields and unexpected values.
  • Migration and import: Prepare tabular data for a CRM, ERP, or finance system.

How to convert JSON to Excel

  1. Prepare the array: Make sure the input is a JSON array of objects; wrap a single object in an array.
  2. Choose options: Enable flattening for nested data and decide whether to include a header row.
  3. Preview: Confirm the column names, row count, and flattening result look right.
  4. Download: Export the .xlsx workbook, or copy the rows as CSV text to paste into a sheet.
  5. Double-check: In your spreadsheet, review numbers, dates, and empty values.

How nested JSON becomes columns

Sheets are two-dimensional, so nested structures must be flattened. With flattening enabled:

  • Nested objects: Dotted column names such as address.city, at any depth.
  • Arrays of objects: Indexed column names such as items.0.name.
  • Arrays of simple values: Written as JSON text in one cell, because a single column cannot safely hold a list of varying length.
  • Missing fields: Left as empty cells so rows stay aligned with columns.

Different tools flatten nested structures differently, so preview before exporting.

Data types and empty values

Numbers and booleans are written as cells of that type and can be sorted or calculated directly. Null and missing fields become empty cells. Dates stay as the original JSON strings, because JSON has no date type and the tool cannot reliably tell whether a string is a date; convert them in your spreadsheet when you need real date cells.

XLSX vs CSV

XLSX is a workbook format: one file can hold worksheets, cells carry type information, and spreadsheet apps open it by double-clicking. CSV is plain text with delimiters, and regional defaults for separators and encoding can differ. This page downloads XLSX; the Copy CSV button only puts the same rows on the clipboard as comma-separated text for quick pasting.

Limitations to keep in mind

  • Input must be an array: A root object errors; extract its array first.
  • One worksheet: A single conversion produces one sheet.
  • Very large arrays: Limited by browser memory; sample or split first if needed.
  • No type conversion: Dates and number precision should be reviewed in the sheet.

Browser-based privacy

The workbook is generated in your browser and the JSON is not sent to a remote conversion service, which is convenient for everyday development and data work. It is not a secret-management system, so avoid pasting passwords, API keys, access tokens, or production customer data into any browser tool.

faq.question: 这会生成真正的 Excel XLSX 文件吗？
faq.answer: 会。下载得到的是真实的 .xlsx 工作簿，包含一个名为 Sheet1 的工作表，可以直接在 Excel、Google Sheets 和 LibreOffice Calc 中打开，不需要按文本导入。

faq.question: 可以选择逗号、分号或制表符分隔吗？
faq.answer: XLSX 下载不使用分隔符，因此不需要分隔符设置。CSV 复制按钮固定使用逗号，因为粘贴文本时表格软件通常按逗号识别列。

faq.question: 什么样的 JSON 结构最合适？
faq.answer: 最合适的是 JSON 对象数组，每个对象是一条记录。扁平对象每个键导出为一列；嵌套对象在开启展平后会转成带点号的列。

faq.question: 可以转换 JSON 对象而不是数组吗？
faq.answer: 不可以，输入必须是 JSON 数组。可以把单个对象包成数组，例如 `[{ ... }]`，或者只取对象里的那个数组，例如接口响应中的 `items` 数组。

faq.question: 支持嵌套的 JSON 对象吗？
faq.answer: 开启展平后支持。嵌套对象会变成 `address.city` 这样的点号列，对象数组变成 `items.0.name` 这样的带索引列，简单值数组则以 JSON 文本写入。关闭该选项就不会把嵌套对象展开成列。

faq.question: 是导出全部字段，还是只导出第一条记录的字段？
faq.answer: 列是从数组中所有记录收集的。某条记录缺少某个字段时，对应单元格留空，因此即使各条记录字段不一致，行也不会错位。

faq.question: 数字、布尔值、日期和 null 会怎么导出？
faq.answer: 数字和布尔值会写成对应类型的单元格；null 和缺失值写成空白单元格；日期保持原始 JSON 字符串，如果需要真正的日期单元格，请在表格里再转换一次。

faq.question: 可以去掉表头行吗？
faq.answer: 可以。关闭表头选项后，工作簿和 CSV 复制都只包含数据行，适合往已有表格下方追加。

faq.question: 可以导出多个工作表吗？
faq.answer: 不可以，一次转换只生成一个工作表。如果需要多个工作表，请分别转换每个数组，再在表格软件里合并。

faq.question: 可以转换很大的 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 实际可处理的大小取决于浏览器内存、设备性能和记录条数。非常大的数组展平和导出都会更慢，并可能耗尽可用内存。

faq.question: 我的 JSON 会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 工作簿在你的浏览器本地生成，不需要上传服务器。但仍不建议在任何浏览器工具中输入密码、API 密钥、令牌或机密的客户数据。

faq.question: 这个 JSON 转 Excel 转换器免费吗？
faq.answer: 免费，且无需注册账号。你可以粘贴 JSON 或打开文件，预览数据行后下载 XLSX 工作簿。

article.title: 如何在线将 JSON 转换为 Excel
article.content:
JSON 转 Excel 转换器做了什么？

JSON 转 Excel 转换器会把 JSON 对象数组转换成一张 XLSX 工作表：每个数组元素是一行，检测到的字段是列。下载得到的是真正的工作簿文件，而不是需要再用导入向导处理一遍的文本。

它做的是结构转换，不是数据分析：不会生成图表、透视表或公式，也不会判断哪些字段该合并。

常见使用场景

  • 业务分析：把接口返回的记录导出成表格，交给同事用 Excel 分析。
  • 数据交付：为运营、财务或客户提供可以直接打开的表格文件。
  • 排查核对：把一批记录铺平成行，人工检查字段缺失和异常值。
  • 迁移导入：把 JSON 数据整理成 CRM、ERP 或财务系统可导入的表格。

如何将 JSON 转换为 Excel

  1. 准备数组：确保输入是 JSON 对象数组；单个对象请包成数组。
  2. 选择选项：嵌套数据开启展平，并决定是否包含表头行。
  3. 预览：确认列名、行数和展平结果符合预期。
  4. 下载：导出 .xlsx 工作簿，或复制为 CSV 文本粘贴到表格里。
  5. 复核：在表格软件里检查数字、日期和空值是否符合预期。

嵌套 JSON 如何变成列

表格是二维结构，因此需要把嵌套结构摊平。开启展平后：

  • 嵌套对象：`address.city` 这样的点号列名，层级深度不限。
  • 对象数组：`items.0.name` 这类带索引的列名。
  • 简单值数组：以 JSON 文本写入单元格，因为一列无法安全地表达不定长的列表。
  • 缺失字段：留空单元格，保证行与列对齐。

不同工具对嵌套结构的处理规则并不统一，导出前先看一眼预览，比事后在表格里修更快。

数据类型与空值

数字和布尔值会写成同类型的单元格，可以直接参与排序和计算。null 和缺失字段写成空白单元格。日期保持原始 JSON 字符串，因为 JSON 没有日期类型，工具无法可靠判断字符串是不是日期；需要真正的日期单元格时，请在表格里转换。

XLSX 与 CSV 的区别

XLSX 是工作簿格式，一个文件里可以有多个工作表，单元格带类型信息，双击即可用表格软件打开。CSV 是纯文本，用分隔符表示列，不同地区的默认分隔符和编码处理都可能造成差异。

本页下载的是 XLSX；CSV 按钮只是把同样的数据以逗号分隔文本复制到剪贴板，方便直接粘贴。

需要留意的限制

  • 输入必须是数组：根对象会报错，请先取出其中的数组。
  • 单个工作表：一次转换只产生一个工作表。
  • 超大数组：受浏览器内存限制，可能需要先抽样或分片。
  • 不做类型转换：日期、金额精度等需要在表格里复核。

浏览器本地处理与隐私

工作簿在你的浏览器中生成，不需要把 JSON 上传到远程转换服务，这对日常开发和数据处理更方便。但它不是密钥管理方案，请勿在浏览器工具中粘贴密码、API 密钥、访问令牌或生产环境的敏感数据。
